title: Does The Way You Plan Matter? An Empirical Study of Planning Representations for LLM Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.29927v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite recent advances, LLM-based web agents still struggle with limited exploration, omission of critical steps, and sensitivity to task constraints. Prior work suggests that many of these failures stem from weaknesses in planning, yet the impact of alternative natural language plan representations remains unexplored. To address this, we introduce PlanAhead, a static planner-executor framework that evaluates the impact of plan representation on agent performance. We first automatically categorize WebArena tasks into 3 difficulty levels, enabling consistent difficulty grading without human annotation. Then we systematically evaluate 4 different plan representations on the tasks categorized as hard: sequential subgoals, narrative, pseudocode, and checklist; across different families of multimodal LLM-powered agents(OpenAI, Alibaba, and Google). To account for stochastic variability, we introduce a novel decomposition of agent S

translated_title: 计划的表达方式重要吗？关于LLM网页代理计划表示的实证研究
translated_abstract: 尽管近期取得了进展，基于LLM的网页代理仍然存在探索能力有限、遗漏关键步骤以及对任务约束敏感等问题。先前的研究表明，这些失败大多源于规划能力的不足，然而不同自然语言计划表示方式的影响仍未被探索。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了PlanAhead，一个静态的规划器-执行器框架，用于评估计划表示对代理性能的影响。我们首先自动将WebArena任务分类为3个难度级别，无需人工标注即可实现一致的难度分级。随后，我们在被归类为困难的任务上，系统地评估了4种不同的计划表示方式：顺序子目标、叙述性描述、伪代码和检查清单；并在不同家族的多模态LLM驱动的代理（OpenAI、阿里巴巴和谷歌）上进行了测试。为了考虑随机变异性，我们引入了一种新颖的代理成功分解方法……
tldr: 本文提出PlanAhead框架，系统评估了四种自然语言计划表示（顺序子目标、叙述、伪代码、检查清单）对多模态LLM网页代理性能的影响，并实现了无需人工标注的自动任务难度分级。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PlanAhead, a static planner-executor framework that systematically evaluates the impact of four natural language plan representations (sequential subgoals, narrative, pseudocode, and checklist) on multimodal LLM web agents' performance, along with automatic task difficulty grading without human annotation.
